title: Woooo!
novel:
Lily felt [[neglected|neglect]] by her friends. Everyone was busy with their own lives, and she felt [[invisible|invisible]]. Then she met a group of [[boisterous|boisterous]] women at a bar — the "Woo Girls." They [[screamed|scream]] "Woooo!" at everything and [[celebrated|celebrate]] every moment.

Lily joined them and felt [[alive|alive]] again. She [[laughed|laugh]] louder than she had in months. The Woo Girls were [[obnoxious|obnoxious]] but [[enthusiastic|enthusiastic]], and Lily loved every minute.

Meanwhile, Robin [[interviewed|interview]] for a new job at a morning show. The [[producer|producer]] was [[intimidating|intimidating]]. Robin felt [[nervous|nervous]] but [[determined|determined]].

"Why should we hire you?" the producer asked.

Robin took a breath. "Because I [[refuse|refuse]] to give up."

Ted [[finished|finish]] his building design. He [[submitted|submit]] it to the city council, feeling [[proud|proud]] and [[anxious|anxious]] at the same time. Years of work had led to this moment.

Lily came home late, [[exhausted|exhaust]] from partying. Marshall looked at her with a [[puzzled|puzzle]] expression. "You were out with the Woo Girls again?"

"They make me feel young," Lily [[admitted|admit]].

Marshall smiled. "You don't need Woo Girls for that."

The next day, Robin got the job. She [[screamed|scream]] "Woooo!" — just once — and then laughed at herself.

neglect.en: to not give enough attention to someone

scream.en: to make a loud high cry

celebrate.en: to do something enjoyable for a special day

laugh.en: to make sounds and movements that show joy

interview.en: to have a formal meeting for a job

producer.en: the person in charge of making a show

intimidating.en: making you feel nervous or afraid

proud.en: feeling good about what you have done

anxious.en: feeling worried about what might happen

admit.en: to agree that something is true
